title: Medical foundation large language models for comprehensive text analysis and beyond

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Medical foundation large language models for comprehensive text analysis and beyond》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We evaluated Me-LLaMA on six text analysis tasks using 12 benchmarks (e.g., PubMedQA and MIMIC-CXR) and assessed its clinical utility in complex case diagnosis through automatic and human evaluations.
